rules.description: Ensure all 3 Susenas literacy StatVars share the same latest year.
Ensure all 75 SIMDASI/yearbook school, teacher, and student StatVars share the same latest year.
Verify all 78 StatVars, observation counts, non-negative values, percentage bounds, place coverage, and annual freshness with a 2-year lag safe for January runs before BPS's February release.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sv_count, COALESCE(SUM(NumObservations), 0) AS total_obs, MIN(MinValue) AS min_val, MAX(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_Person_15OrMoreYears_.*Literate_') THEN MaxValue ELSE 0 END) AS max_literacy_val, MIN(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(School|Teacher|Student|CollegeOrUniversity)_') THEN NumPlaces ELSE 39 END) AS min_school_places, MIN(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(StatVar, '^Count_(School|Teacher|Student|CollegeOrUniversity)_') THEN NumObservations ELSE 300 END) AS min_school_obs, MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(MaxDate AS VARCHAR), 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) AS min_max_date FROM stats
params.condition: sv_count = 78 AND total_obs >= 24000 AND min_val >= 0 AND max_literacy_val <= 100 AND min_school_places >= 35 AND min_school_obs >= 250 AND min_max_date >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) - 2
